protocol_title: Vinflunine Plus Capecitabine in Advanced Breast Cancer

findings.missing_exclusion: Protocol does not exclude or screen for DPYD deficiency before capecitabine dosing (CPIC Level A; test before fluoropyrimidines).

notes: *9A/M166V (rs1801265) carrier frequency in South Asian cohorts: Hariprakash 2018, Naushad 2021, and Atasilp 2025 give incompatible estimates.
Expected excess grade >=3 fluoropyrimidine toxicity among IM vs NM: literature range 1.8x-3.2x — multiplier not pinned for Tier 0.
Scenario: mandatory DPYD pre-screening at Mumbai and Kochi removes ~3.5 expected IM+PM enrollees from active dosing cohort.
Scenario: if 20% of at-risk patients discontinue in cycle 1, Mumbai site loses ~0.7 evaluable patients — directional only.
